name: CWM RHONDDA
source: Open Hymnal Project ABC score (The Methodist Hymn Book, 1933); every note agrees with the score on Wikipedia's Cwm Rhondda article (printed there in 4/2 in A flat) and the opening with hymnary.org's incipit.
reviewNotes: High. Notes and rhythm agree in both sources. The sopranos hold 'more' a whole bar while the lower voices echo 'want no more' (only the melody is shown). Many books print it in A flat; the solfa is the same.
